<!-- GENERATED by scripts/compile-contracts.mjs from contracts/rules. Edit the rule files, then run npm run contracts:compile. -->

- **invariant** `wizard/keep-prepare-erase-offer-never-applied`: Keep Prepare erase an OFFER and never applied pixels. `proposeEraseRect` scans on arrival so the strongest path is not opt-in, re-run on the CLEANED artwork after every accepted erase, and under the confidence bar propose NOTHING while naming the rule that refused. Keep its overlay CSS capability-local in `import/prepProposal.css`, never in `src/styles/`.
- **invariant** `wizard/keep-whole-import-graphic-capability-inside`: Keep the whole Import-graphic capability inside `wizard/import/` - the five steps, `DesignPrepCanvas`, `fieldAutoMap`, its CSS and its draft slice - with `import/index.ts` as the ONLY door into it. `.dependency-cruiser.cjs` refuses a deep import from outside, `draft.ts` re-exports the slice through that index, and `scripts/e2e-affected.mjs` maps the folder to the import specs.
- **invariant** `wizard/let-geometry-propose-followers-author-edit`: Let geometry propose followers and the author edit them: `proposeFollowers` measures the runtime guess on the step render, outermost-first, never a group AND its contents. An untouched proposal emits NOTHING because the runtime derives it, and the FIRST EDIT materializes the whole set into `svgStretch.followers`. Render the list only where there is something to decide, and let growth alone open nothing.
- **invariant** `wizard/measure-ink-erase-removes-split-lines`: MEASURE the ink an erase removes, split into LINES, and seed every field at create from that line own bounds, cap height, top and the edge it was set from - never from the loose rectangle the user drew. FieldsStep and StyleStep carry NO imported-design branches, because design mode never reaches them.
- **invariant** `wizard/offer-too-long-control-ladder-owner`: Offer the too-long control as a LADDER in the owner order - wider, wider-then-wrap, wrap, smaller, with shrink LAST - emitting `xy` as two rows on one panel. Never size against the frame, and re-derive with the rows until a growth control is touched.
- **invariant** `wizard/take-every-downstream-number-mode-artwork`: Take every downstream number in `design` mode from the artwork INTRINSIC pixel size. Offer Create from the Design step on, so every later step is an optional stop. Field specs live in `draft.designFields` in DESIGN pixels and become real placed fields at build through `withDesignFieldSpecs`, so wizard placement, editor, preview and export agree by construction.
- **invariant** `wizard/treat-import-graphic-setup-flow-second`: Treat Import graphic as a SETUP flow, not a second editor. Its one drop zone takes three MODES and never a branch: `design` for any raster, `svg` for the mapping step alone, and `file` for a finished template. What each step DOES is owned by docs/IMPORT_MVP.md and docs/SVG_IMPORT_PLAN.md; only what the wizard itself owns belongs here.
- **trap** `wizard/accumulate-erase-marks-each-run-against`: Accumulate erase marks into `draft.designErases`, each run against the artwork as it stands, and REPLAY the survivors from `draft.designOriginal` when one is removed. A fill cannot be undone in place.
- **trap** `wizard/spread-every-handler-patches-make-visible`: SPREAD `svgStretch` in every handler that patches it. Make `followArmed` a visible MODE rather than a modifier, so an armed pick toggles a FOLLOWER and a pick on text does nothing.
- **rule** `wizard/decide-drag-before-binding-kinds-picture`: Decide a DRAG before the binding kinds on a picture-filled backplate holding both roles on one marker, so a click ticks the picture and the ladder turns growth off. The canvas answers WHICH layer and the step decides what a pick MEANS. Anything spreading the inventories dedupes by id.
- **rule** `wizard/hold-meant-there-baked-text-draft`: Hold "it is meant to be there / no baked text" as DRAFT state in `designKeepBakedText`, cleared by marking it and reset by a fresh drop. Have the Text step re-scan and SAY SO when detected text remains un-erased, offering a back-to-Prepare door beside the keep answer, and never block Next: the fact travels.
- **rule** `wizard/measure-growth-default-where-artwork-unambiguous`: MEASURE the growth default with `proposeBannerGrowth` where the artwork is unambiguous: a banner rectangle whose STACKED bound lines are all start-anchored, with room before the margin, defaults to the whole grow ladder. A pair sharing one baseline argues neither way; no stacked line, a non-start anchor, a full-frame backplate or a quiz behaviour keep shrink and the step asks.
- **rule** `wizard/offer-panel-picker-only-shapes-bound`: Offer in the panel picker only shapes a bound line sits in, drawn OR placed - the pair `svgFitNodes` walks - because the runtime grants any other zero.
- **rule** `wizard/take-finished-template-mode-through-two`: Take a finished template in `file` mode through a two-stop rail with the imported template as its own preview and the ordinary Finish doors, skipping Prepare, Text and Animation by having a MODE rather than a branch. Apply its code BYTE-FAITHFULLY, never through the formatter: the graphic NAME is the only edit.
